component.name: Tapewright
component.summary: Design and print labels on Brother P-touch printers

description.p: Tapewright is a label designer for Brother P-touch USB label printers such as the PT-P700. It talks to the printer directly over USB, so no printer driver is needed.

ul.li: Text in any installed font, auto-sized to the tape
Images, QR codes and Code 128 barcodes
Borders, inverted printing, fixed or automatic length
Live printer status and a dot-accurate preview in the real tape colours
